findings.evidence: The candidate changes two independent process wrappers, but the only new inherited-handle regression invokes Story115ProcessExecutor in the test harness. summary: REVISE. Candidate 0430f3c64ee99c7ee76155ecc6ea24adaac61a81 is clean at tree a8f955c83bde97de2cb2203be58ce359dd9eb832; parent-to-candidate binary diff SHA-256 is ec8ec4db51ce0f170a6cb465baf993ee8e8733085d8f229c7fd3383dcb4137be and git diff --check passes. The four-path correction is narrow: it links redirected stream drains to the existing cancellation deadline in production CodeGraphContextProvider and the release executor, adds one inherited-handle harness regression, and records the failed live attempt. Fresh bounded non-live checks pass 58/58 for the new executor test plus CodeGraphContextProviderTests and 52/52 for the complete release harness; the repository workflow validator passes. The supplied failed-attempt evidence truthfully reports first-Repository profiling, the overnight inherited-handle hang, exact-nonce provisioner removal, successful harness cleanup, independent zero-residue checks, and an unchanged healthy external PostgreSQL 17 instance. The changed path set contains no Scan strategy, seven-slot Pass 2 contract, migration/model, Docker topology, Dockerfile, compose, provider identity, or package/lock change. Two High blockers remain: stale ignored candidate activation metadata and no regression that actually exercises the changed production process wrapper. T072 is not accepted-safe to retry on this boundary.
